back: Any person or group with an interest in a business because they are affected by its activities.
Customers, suppliers, lenders, government, local community, competitors.
A shareholder owns shares in a company. A stakeholder is anyone affected by the business; shareholders are one type.

front: What do customers and employees want?
back: Customers: quality, fair prices, good service. Employees: fair wages, safe conditions, job security, training.
Replacing workers with machines: owners gain lower costs, employees lose jobs.

front: How can a business reduce stakeholder conflict?
back: Prioritise, consult and communicate, compromise, act responsibly (CSR).

front: What do lenders and government want?
back: Lenders: repayment with interest on time. Government: taxes, jobs, legal behaviour.
